title: Seminar: Theory and Performance Studies; Translations, Adaptations, and Appropriations
description: This section of THET608 examines translations, adaptations, and appropriations of Shakespeare's plays. Topics to be covered include models of translation, theories of adaptation and appropriation, and performance as adaptation. Texts to be analyzed include recorded and live performances of Hamlet, King Lear, and Twelfth Night. Junior and senior Undergraduates may enroll with instructor permission.
